或然負債                                   Contingent Liabilities

根據按揭合約，銀行要求本集團向買家的按揭                   Pursuant to the mortgage contracts, banks require the Group to
貸款提供擔保。預售住宅物業按揭擔保一般於                   guarantee its purchasers’ mortgage loans. Guarantees for mortgages on
下列最早者解除：(i)政府機關向買家發放房地                 pre-sold residential properties are generally discharged at: (i) the issue
產所有權證時；或(ii)買家結清物業的按揭貸款                of the real estate ownership certificate by government authorities to the
時。倘買家拖欠按揭貸款，則本集團須負責償                   purchaser; or (ii) the satisfaction of mortgage loans by the purchasers
還餘下之按揭本金連同拖欠之買方欠付銀行之                   of the properties (whichever is earliest). If a purchaser defaults on
應計利息及罰金，及本集團有權接管相關物業                   a mortgage loan, the Group is responsible to repay the outstanding
的法定業權及所有權。本集團的擔保期通常自                   mortgage principal together with accrued interest and penalties owed
授出按揭日期開始。                              by the defaulting purchasers to the banks and the Group is entitled to
                                       take over the legal title and possession of the related properties. The
                                       Group’s guarantee period typically starts from the date of grant of the
                                       mortgage.

為評估購股權公允價值普遍使用的一種模式。                   The Model is one of the commonly used models to estimate the fair
計算購股權公允價值時使用的變數及假設乃按                   value of an option. The variables and assumptions used in computing
管理層之最佳評估。購股權的價值會視乎多個                   the fair value of the share options are based on the management’s
主觀假設之變數而計算出不同的估值。任何已                   best estimate. The value of an option varies with different variables of
採用之變數倘出現變動，可能會對購股權公允                   a number of subjective assumptions. Any change in the variables so
價值之估計產生重大影響。                           adopted may materially affect the estimation of the fair value of an
                                       option.

      乎多個主觀假設之變數而計算出不同的估值。                                    best estimate. The value of an option varies with different variables of
      任何已採用之變數倘出現變動，可能會對購股                                    a number of subjective assumptions. Any change in the variables so
      權公允價值之估計產生重大影響。                                         adopted may materially affect the estimation of the fair value of an

  風險管理及內部監控                             RISK MANAGEMENT AND INTERNAL CONTROL
  風險管理及內部監控系統                           Risk Management and Internal Control Systems

  風險管理及內部監控系統主要包括董事會、審                  The Board, the Audit Committee, the senior management and the
  核委員會、高級管理層及內部審核部門組成的                  internal audit department are the four levels of structure and main
  四級架構。                                 features of risk management and internal control systems.


  董事會明白，董事會須負責維持充分的風險管                  The Board acknowledges that it is the responsibility of the Board
  理及內部監控系統，以保障股東的投資及本公                  for maintaining an adequate risk management and internal control
  司的資產，並每年審閱該制度的有效性。風險                  systems to safeguard the investments of Shareholders and assets of the
  管理及內部監控系統旨在管理而非消除未能達                  Company and reviewing the effectiveness of such systems on an annual
  成業務目標的風險，而且只能就不會有重大的                  basis. Risk management and internal control systems are designed to
  失實陳述或損失作出合理而非絕對的保證。                   manage rather than eliminate the risk of failure to achieve business

  管理程序，以識別、評估及管理重大風險，並                      developed a risk management process to identify, evaluate and manage

  過本公司的內部審核部門負責年度風險呈報程                      Senior management, through the Company’s internal audit department,
  序。內部審核部門的成員與高級管理層若干成                      is responsible for the annual risk reporting process. Members of the

  的任何變動，對風險進行匯總、評級並記錄緩                      material internal control defects (if any), including any changes relevant

發展計劃。違反質量、安全、環境標準的供應       cooperative relationship development plans accordingly. Suppliers who
商將被及時錄入系統，並視違規情節嚴重程度       violate quality, safety and environmental standards will be recorded into
將其列入供應商黑名單並取消合作資格或採取       the system in a timely manner and listed on the supplier blacklist, and
法律手段予以處置。                  disqualified for cooperation or punished by legal measures according to
                           the severity of the violation.

     海綿城市                                 Sponge city


本集團以「生態為本，自然循環」為原則，推               Based on the principle of “Maintaining ecological balance through
進海綿城市建設，期望借助城市「海綿體」加               recycling”, the Group advances the construction of a sponge city in an
強水循環利用，減少廢水和污染物排放。本集               effort to strengthen water recycling and reduce the discharge of waste
團制定了《海綿城市專項設計流程指引》以及               water and pollutants with the help of urban “spongy body”. The Group
嚴格的海綿城市專項驗收流程，為海綿城市建               has formulated the Guidelines on Sponge City Design Process and
設提供技術支持。                           high-standard specific acceptance process to provide technical support
                                   for sponge city construction.


長沙高鐵吾悅廣場因地制宜採用生態化排水，               Changsha Gaotie Wuyue Plaza (長沙高鐵吾悅廣場) applies ecological
在場地內採用雨水花園、下凹式綠地、傳輸型               drainage system according to local conditions. It took various “Sponge”
植草溝及透水鋪裝等各項「海綿」措施，通過               measures such as rain garden, concave greenbelt, transmission-type
科學規劃使該項目發揮「海綿」作用，改善城               grass planting ditch and permeable pavement to achieve “Sponge”
市生態環境。                             effect and improved the urban ecological environment through scientific
                                   planning.

       本集團選擇自2019年1月1日起採納「香                              The Group elected to adopt the “Amendments to HKFRS 3 –
       港財務報告準則第3號（修訂本) － 業務                              Definition of a Business” from 1 January 2019.
       的定義」。


       業務的定義已修改。如要被視為業務，                                 The definition of a business was amended. To be considered
       收購必須包括一項投入及一項實質性流                                 a business, an acquisition would have to include an input and
       程，兩者共同對創造產出的能力有重大                                 a substantive process that together significantly contribute
       貢獻。新指引提供用於評估投入及實質                                 to the ability to create outputs. The new guidance provides
       性流程存在時間的框架。新模式亦引入                                 a framework to evaluate when an input and a substantive
       選擇性的集中測試，倘符合有關測試，                                 process are present. The new model also introduces an optional
       則毋須進一步評估。                                         concentration test that, if met, eliminates the need for further
                                                         assessment.

       或然負債乃一項因過往事件可能產生的                                 A contingent liability is a possible obligation that arises from
       承擔，而該責任的出現僅可由一項或多                                 past events and whose existence will only be confirmed by the
       項並非由本集團全權控制之日後不明朗                                 occurrence or non-occurrence of one or more uncertain future

       不大可能需要動用經濟資源或承擔之金                                 be a present obligation arising from past events that is not

       產生之現有承擔。                                          resources will be required or the amount of obligation cannot be

       或然負債不予確認，惟會於合併財務報                                 A contingent liability is not recognised but is disclosed in the

       本集團比較報告日期與初步確認日期之                                 throughout each reporting period. To assess whether there’s a

           本集團的資本管理目標乃為保障本集團                                  The Group’s objectives when managing capital are to safeguard
           繼續營運的能力，以為股東提供回報和                                  the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern in order to
           維持最佳的資本結構以降低資金成本。                                  provide returns for shareholders and to maintain an optimal
                                                              capital structure to reduce the cost of capital.


           為維持或調整資本結構，本集團可能會                                  In order to maintain or adjust the capital structure, the Group
           調整派付予股東的股息金額、發行新股                                  may adjust the amount of dividends paid to shareholders, issue
           份或出售資產以減少債務。                                       new shares or sell assets to reduce debt.


           本集團根據資產負債比率監察其資本。                                  The Group monitors capital on the basis of the gearing ratio.
           此比率按照債務淨額除以資本總額計                                   This ratio is calculated as net debt divided by total capital.
           算。債務淨額為借款總額減去現金及現                                  Net debt is calculated as total borrowings less cash and cash
           金等價物。資本總額按合併財務狀況表                                  equivalents. Total capital is calculated as total equity, as shown in
           所列示的權益總額加上債務淨額計算。                                  the consolidated statement of financial position, plus net debt.
